messages.task:
You are a financial data analyst.  Answer the user’s question by thoughtfully reasoning step-by-step and invoking the available tools whenever needed.  Return only the final numeric answer (no commentary).

Scenario
--------
Entergy New Orleans, Inc. and its subsidiaries released a management discussion and analysis of operations.  The narrative explains that, when comparing 2016 with 2015, net income increased mainly because of higher net revenue even though depreciation, amortization, interest expense and other income trends were unfavorable.  Earlier, the company had reported that 2015 net income versus 2014 also improved thanks to lower operating and maintenance costs and higher net revenue, partly offset by a higher effective income-tax rate.

In the discussion of “Net revenue – 2016 compared to 2015,” management states that net revenue represents operating revenues net of (1) fuel, fuel-related expenses and gas purchased for resale, (2) purchased-power expenses, and (3) other regulatory charges.  The report then provides an analysis of the change in net revenue between the two years and details drivers such as retail-electric price, net-gas revenue, volume/weather effects and other items.  The accompanying paragraph further notes that the retail-electric price variance is tied to an increase in a cost-recovery rider, effective with March 2016 bills and associated with the purchase of Power Block 1 of the Union Power Station.  Weather impacts on residential and commercial gas sales, plus shifts in billed electricity usage and customer counts, are also discussed.

Tools available
---------------
get_company_id(company_name) ➜ numeric identifier for a company name
get_metric_id(metric_name)   ➜ numeric identifier for a financial metric
get_financial_fact(company_id, year, metric_id) ➜ value stored for a (company, year, metric) tuple (values are in millions of U.S. dollars)
subtract_numbers(minuend, subtrahend)           ➜ returns minuend − subtrahend
round_to_decimals(value, decimals)              ➜ rounds a number to the requested decimal places
list_available_companies()                      ➜ list of all companies contained in the database
list_metrics_for_company(company_id)            ➜ list of metrics recorded for a company
get_average_temperature(station_name, start_date, end_date) ➜ mean temperature for a weather station (irrelevant environmental data)
get_fuel_price(fuel_name, date)                 ➜ market price for a fuel on a specific date (additional environmental data)

Question
--------
What is the net change in net revenue during 2016 for Entergy New Orleans, Inc.?
